blocks.raw: To create or edit push notifications for a campaign, follow these steps:
blocks.text: To create or edit push notifications for a campaign, follow these steps:

blocks.raw:
1. [Create a new campaign](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/create-a-campaign) or [edit an existing one](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/modify-a-campaign).
2. In the **Content** section of your campaign, click on **Add Creative** and choose **Push notification**from the options.

blocks.raw: To create or edit push notifications for a journey, follow these steps:
blocks.text: To create or edit push notifications for a journey, follow these steps:

blocks.raw:
1. Create a new journey.
2. While configuring the journey, choose **M-push** to trigger push notifications.
3. Hover over the **MPUSH block** and click on the **settings** icon next to it.

   <Image align="center" border={true} src="https://files.readme.io/2675d36-image.png" className="border" />
4. Provide a unique **Engagement Name** and click on **Add Creative**.

   <Image align="center" border={true} src="https://files.readme.io/ca49cd1-image.png" className="border" />
5. Choose the **Mobilepush Account** to send the content.
6. [Create a new template](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/create-push-notification-template#/) or choose from existing templates.
7. View the notification preview on the right side.
8. Click on **Done** to save the changes.
